verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud markets natural-language understanding of production systems [grafana-docs-8] and an AI-powered Grafana Assistant and Investigations [grafana-docs-45], with insights available "no complex queries required" [grafana-docs-44]. Agents can also act on Grafana through official hosted and self-managed MCP servers [grafana-docs-7][grafana-probe-4]. The evidence is marketing-level and centers on understanding and investigating rather than operating, and it applies to Grafana Cloud rather than OSS. Missing for 10: documentation of which actions natural-language commands can perform (e.g. creating dashboards, alerts or queries), coverage beyond Grafana Cloud, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
